description: SAP Clean Core Solution Advisor - Enhanced Security Configuration with ABAC and Role Collections

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.Admin
scopes.description: Full system administrator with unrestricted access to all resources, users, and configurations across all tenants

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.TenantAdmin
scopes.description: Tenant Administrator - Full access to project configuration, user management, and all analyses within assigned tenant

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.ProjectAdmin
scopes.description: Project Administrator - Manage specific project details and analyses within assigned projects (attribute-based)

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.SolutionArchitect
scopes.description: Solution Architect - Create, edit, and export clean core analyses with full scoring access

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.Developer
scopes.description: Developer/Consultant - Execute wizard, view results, and access examples (read-only for other users' analyses)

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.Viewer
scopes.description: Read-only access to analyses and reports without edit or export capabilities

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.ServiceProviderAdmin
scopes.description: Service Provider Administrator - Cross-tenant analytics and master data management for SaaS operations

attributes.name: projectId
attributes.description: Project assignment for attribute-based access control - limits access to specific projects

attributes.name: tenantId
attributes.description: Tenant identifier for multi-tenant isolation - automatically assigned based on subdomain

attributes.name: userId
attributes.description: User identifier for owner-based access control - users can only edit their own analyses

role-templates.name: Administrator
role-templates.description: System Administrator - Unrestricted access to all application features, master data management, and cross-tenant operations. Assigned to: IT administrators, application owners.

role-templates.name: TenantAdministrator
role-templates.description: Tenant Administrator - Full control within assigned tenant including project creation, user assignment, analysis management, and tenant-specific configuration. Assigned to: Tenant business owners, implementation leads.

role-templates.name: ProjectAdministrator
role-templates.description: Project Administrator - Manage specific S/4HANA implementation projects including project details, RICEFW object configurations, and team member assignments. Cannot delete projects or access other projects. Assigned to: Project managers, implementation coordinators.

role-templates.name: SolutionArchitect
role-templates.description: Solution Architect - Create and manage clean core analyses, run wizard sessions, calculate scoring metrics, export detailed reports (PDF/PNG/SVG), and access constraints/examples library. Can edit own analyses and view others. Assigned to: SAP solution architects, senior consultants.

role-templates.name: DeveloperConsultant
role-templates.description: Developer/Consultant - Execute clean core wizard for RICEFW analysis, view scoring dashboards, access real-world examples and constraints. Read-only access to analyses created by other users. Assigned to: SAP developers, junior consultants, technical analysts.

role-templates.name: Viewer
role-templates.description: Viewer - Read-only access to completed analyses, scoring metrics, and decision flowcharts. Cannot create, edit, or export analyses. Assigned to: Business stakeholders, auditors, compliance officers.

role-templates.name: ServiceProviderAdministrator
role-templates.description: Service Provider Administrator - Cross-tenant master data management, global analytics, system monitoring, and SaaS configuration. Assigned to: SaaS operators, support teams (use with caution).

role-collections.name: SolutionAdvisor_Administrator
role-collections.description: Full system administrator access with unrestricted permissions across all tenants and features

role-collections.name: SolutionAdvisor_TenantAdmin
role-collections.description: Tenant-level administrator for managing projects, users, and analyses within a specific tenant

role-collections.name: SolutionAdvisor_ProjectAdmin
role-collections.description: Project-level administrator for managing specific S/4HANA implementation projects and team assignments

role-collections.name: SolutionAdvisor_SolutionArchitect
role-collections.description: Solution architects who create and manage clean core analyses with full wizard and reporting capabilities

role-collections.name: SolutionAdvisor_Developer
role-collections.description: Developers and consultants who execute wizards and view analysis results

role-collections.name: SolutionAdvisor_Viewer
role-collections.description: Read-only access for stakeholders and auditors to view completed analyses and reports

role-collections.name: SolutionAdvisor_ServiceProviderAdmin
role-collections.description: SaaS operations team with cross-tenant access for master data and system management
